requirements.statement: Taking an Ethernet view MUST NOT panic for any byte slice, and MUST return no view when the slice is shorter than the header it announces.

acceptance.given: every byte slice up to 24 octets with each tag identifier at offsets 12 and 16
acceptance.then: it returns without panicking, and returns a view only when the announced header fits

acceptance.given: randomised byte slices up to 1600 octets
acceptance.then: nothing panics and the payload lies inside the slice
acceptance.when: a view is taken and every field and the payload are read

acceptance.then: whenever the filter accepts, the view's EtherType is in S
acceptance.when: the filter for a set S is run through Program::run and the view is taken

requirements.statement: Building a frame MUST leave the growable buffer, or the returned prefix of a fixed slice, holding exactly the new frame, with any padding zero, whatever the buffer held before; a fixed slice too small MUST yield an error, not a partial frame.

acceptance.given: a buffer filled with 1518 octets of 0xAA
acceptance.then: the buffer is 60 octets long and octets 19 to 59 are zero
acceptance.when: a frame with a 5-octet payload is built into it

acceptance.then: the returned length is 60 and octets 19 to 59 of the slice are zero
acceptance.when: a frame with a 5-octet payload is written into it

acceptance.given: a fixed slice shorter than the frame
acceptance.then: an error names the size needed and no length is returned
acceptance.when: a frame is written into it
